cards.quote: Guadalajara, Mexico - In a proud moment for the University of Guadalajara, it has come to light that esteemed researcher Ki Ho Seol is an alumnus of the prestigious institution. Seol, known for his groundbreaking work in various fields, has been making waves in the scientific community for years, and his connection to the university is a testament to its commitment to fostering academic excellence. According to university records, Ki Ho Seol attended the University of Guadalajara in the early 2000s, where he pursued a degree in biology.
